facts.fact: The Cabinet Thomas Dingamgoto analysis says Loi n°007/PR/2015 gives ANSICE the formalities for data transfers, while the agency's operational effectiveness is not documented.
The Cabinet Thomas Dingamgoto analysis applies Loi n°007/PR/2015 to personal data and treats its articles 29 to 32 as the current transfer regime.
The analysis says the law requires notification to or prior authorisation from ANSICE for transfers, and that the agency's operational effectiveness is not documented.
The Cabinet Thomas Dingamgoto analysis applies Loi n°007/PR/2015 to personal data, including transfers abroad under articles 29 to 32.

The Cabinet Thomas Dingamgoto analysis says articles 29 to 32 of Loi n°007/PR/2015 require a legal basis, adequate safeguards and notification or prior authorisation by ANSICE for sending personal data out of Chad.
